siftei_kohen.he:
בשר צבאים שדומה לבשר עגלים. ויש לחוש שמא מוכר בשר בכור של עגלים: **** ENGLISH **** Meat of deer that resembles veal meat — and one should be concerned lest he sell firstborn calf meat.
אבל לוקחים ממנו כו'. מפני שאינו עושה מלאכות אלו בשל בכור שהוא מפחד לשהות אצלו שמא ישמעו הדיינים ויקנסוהו כפי רשעו והוא מקפיד מלהפסיד טרחו: **** ENGLISH **** But one may buy from him, etc. — because he does not perform these labors on a firstborn, as he fears to keep it lest the judges hear and fine him according to his wickedness, and he is particular not to lose his labor.
siftei_kohen.en: Venison that resembles veal. There is concern that he may be selling meat of a firstborn calf.

This is stated there in the Mishnah and explained in the Gemara: he is particular about the burden because perhaps the Sages will hear that it is an unblemished firstborn that requires burial, and he will then suffer the loss.
